==About Voicelines==
{{VO
|character                   = Qiuyuan
|language                    = en

<!-- Thoughts -->
|vo_01_01_title              = Thoughts: I
|vo_01_01_file               = {character}{language} Thoughts I.ogg
|vo_01_01_tx                 = {{Extra Effect|Mingting|Mingting|The capital of Huanglong. The nation's political, economic, and cultural center.}}'s eyes are everywhere. When war broke out in {{Extra Effect|Jinzhou|Jinzhou|Jinzhou, a fortified city on the frontier, stands guard against the looming Tacet Discord crisis. As one of Huanglong's six major regions, it bears the weight of this responsibility as the youngest provincial capital. The Midnight Rangers defend its northern border without hesitation.}}, your profile was submitted to the Grand Library. Within the hour, the briefs reached me. Hm? How do I read these? It's simple: text-to-speech.

|vo_01_02_title              = Thoughts: II
|vo_01_02_intimacy           = 1
|vo_01_02_file               = {character}{language} Thoughts II.ogg
|vo_01_02_tx                 = Rules bind all. Those who breach them must be held to justice, regardless of background or past merits. The {{Extra Effect|Internal Security Agency|Internal Security Agency|An institution that operates independently of the administrative, judicial, and military branches of Huanglong, with the highest official titled "Chief Commander." Reporting directly to the Emperor of Huanglong, it holds the authority to investigate any case, official, or criminal without approval from other agencies, with the power to "act first, report later." Tasked with handling intricate cases year-round, the agency has developed specialized expertise in managing Resonators.}}'s work is never simple. When Grandmaster Liang led, our every action fulfilled our duty to {{Extra Effect|Mingting}} and {{Extra Effect|Huanglong|Huanglong|Located at the edge of the continent, this country borders the sea to the east. It boasts a vast territory with one capital and six major cities.}}'s greater good. But much has changed since...

|vo_01_03_title              = Thoughts: III
|vo_01_03_intimacy           = 2
|vo_01_03_file               = {character}{language} Thoughts III.ogg
|vo_01_03_tx                 = I'm blind, but I can still "see" what's in people's hearts. Arrogance, hatred, malice, pleasure... Through my mind's eye, they take form in shifting hues and silhouettes. But I can't see yours. A rare exception. Maybe, just as she once said—you are exactly as you are.

|vo_01_04_title              = Thoughts: IV
|vo_01_04_intimacy           = 3
|vo_01_04_file               = {character}{language} Thoughts IV.ogg
|vo_01_04_tx                 = For all these years, I've never tasted defeat. Being blind hasn't dulled me. In fact, it sharpens my focus on swordplay. If the opportunity arises, I'd welcome a duel with you.

|vo_01_05_title              = Thoughts: V
|vo_01_05_intimacy           = 4
|vo_01_05_file               = {character}{language} Thoughts V.ogg
|vo_01_05_tx                 = I once wielded this sword only for myself. Then, I drew it for the hand that saved me, and then for {{Extra Effect|Mingting}}. But now, I am a drifter, my sword as aimless as my path... I can't see you, but I can feel your calling. Should you ever need, call my name. This hidden blade shall unsheathe again to defend your faith.


<!-- Miscellaneous -->
|vo_02_01_title              = Qiuyuan's Hobby
|vo_02_01_file               = {character}{language} Hobby.ogg
|vo_02_01_tx                 = Those years I stayed with Master Zhang, I cooked for his patients. Each meal was carefully crafted for their individual need. Beyond those, I know a few spicier dishes from Chongzhou. Whether they suit you, that, I cannot say.

|vo_02_02_title              = Qiuyuan's Trouble
|vo_02_02_file               = {character}{language} Trouble.ogg
|vo_02_02_tx                 = Agents of the {{Extra Effect|Internal Security Agency}} work from a list—names to arrest, names to eliminate. It's all there. Now, only two names remain on mine: the Fractsidus operative who murdered the man who saved my life, and Geshu Lin. Blood debts are paid in blood. That's the natural order. Until my blade ends them, my mission will never end.

|vo_02_03_title              = Favorite Food
|vo_02_03_file               = {character}{language} Favorite Food.ogg
|vo_02_03_tx                 = Years ago, I'd just wrapped up a case in Yuezhou and had to rush back to {{Extra Effect|Mingting}} overnight. I was exhausted and famished when I stumbled into a diner by the roadside. A bowl of rice, braised pork, a bottle of rice wine. A humble meal, yet nothing has ever filled me like that night.

|vo_02_04_title              = Disliked Food
|vo_02_04_file               = {character}{language} Disliked Food.ogg
|vo_02_04_tx                 = {{Extra Effect|Mingting}} has a certain... drink. Greenish-gray, with a smell you don't forget. Trust me, you don't want to find out how it tastes...

|vo_02_05_title              = Ideals
|vo_02_05_file               = {character}{language} Ideals.ogg
|vo_02_05_tx                 = Ideals, wishes... those things mean little to someone who lies down each night unsure if tomorrow comes. So I see no point in dwelling on them. All I know is I can't die yet. Not before I've had my revenge, not before I've fulfilled my duty. What happens after that... I'll leave that to fate to decide.


<!-- Chat -->
|vo_03_01_title              = Chat: I
|vo_03_01_file               = {character}{language} Chat I.ogg
|vo_03_01_tx                 = This is not wine. It's medicine. I was on death's door in Chongzhou when Master Zhang saved me with this potent regimen. But it came at a cost. Ever since then, I've relied on it to "see" with my mind. It sharpens perception but brings the risk of madness. Most people aren't worth my blade, though. For them, this bamboo stick will do.

|vo_03_02_title              = Chat: II
|vo_03_02_file               = {character}{language} Chat II.ogg
|vo_03_02_tx                 = Curious about my past? Heh... if that's what you want, I've no intention to hide. But maybe we should talk over a good pot of wine.


<!-- About Others -->
|vo_04_01_title              = About [[Sanhua]]
|vo_04_01_intimacy           = 1
|vo_04_01_file               = {character}{language} About Sanhua.ogg
|vo_04_01_tx                 = My master once told me some of my ancestors moved from Chongzhou to the borderlands. Sanhua comes from that branch of lineage. Like me, her only interest used to be swordplay. But now, it seems she's found a purpose for her blade in {{Extra Effect|Jinzhou}}'s {{Extra Effect|Magistrate|Magistrate|The Magistrate is a governing official who oversees one of the major regions within Huanglong.}}. I'm glad for her.
|vo_04_01_mention            = Sanhua

|vo_04_02_title              = About [[Changli]]
|vo_04_02_intimacy           = 2
|vo_04_02_file               = {character}{language} About Changli.ogg
|vo_04_02_tx                 = In {{Extra Effect|Mingting}}, people like me rarely got the chance to meet the high-ups—and understandably so. We only show up where there's trouble. As for her, all I know is that ever since she stepped down as Secretary-General, no one's been able to truly fill her place.
|vo_04_02_mention            = Changli

|vo_04_03_title              = About [[Jiyan]]
|vo_04_03_intimacy           = 3
|vo_04_03_file               = {character}{language} About Jiyan.ogg
|vo_04_03_tx                 = Across the troops under {{Extra Effect|Huanglong}}'s {{Extra Effect|Ministry of War|Ministry of War|The Ministry of War is Huanglong's supreme military command, headquartered in Mingting with branches in all six cities. Its leader, the Minister of War, holds supreme command over all military affairs. Authority is delegated to a General in each city, who manages local forces. While Mingting usually appoints these Generals, local Sentinels have the authority to do so in certain special cities.}}, you'd find no one other than him competent enough to earn the title of General at such a young age. I heard he used to be a medic before joining the {{Extra Effect|Midnight Rangers|Midnight Rangers|The Midnight Rangers are a military force under the Jinzhou Ministry of War, commanded by General Jiyan. They consist of three divisions: Outriders (reconnaissance), Vanguard (offensive operations), and Rearguard (defensive operations).}}... He's saving lives, one way or another.
|vo_04_03_mention            = Jiyan

|vo_04_04_title              = About [[Scar]]
|vo_04_04_intimacy           = 4
|vo_04_04_file               = {character}{language} About Scar.ogg
|vo_04_04_tx                 = My knowledge of him only comes from the files. If we ever crossed blades, he wouldn't last three rounds without backup. Though {{Extra Effect|Mingting}} brushed him aside like any other Fractsidus criminal, people in {{Extra Effect|Jinzhou}} would scour the earth for him. Given the gravity of his crime, he's only asking to meet his end.
|vo_04_04_mention            = Scar

|vo_04_05_title              = About Himself
|vo_04_05_intimacy           = 5
|vo_04_05_file               = {character}{language} About Himself.ogg
|vo_04_05_tx                 = Many tried to erase me because they wished to smother the truth. They wouldn't hesitate to murder anyone connected to me, just to bury the cases they're involved in... So, for my and everyone's best interests, the fewer people who know about me, the better.
|vo_04_05_mention            = Qiuyuan


<!-- Birthday -->
|vo_05_01_title              = Birthday Wishes
|vo_05_01_file               = {character}{language} Birthday Wishes.ogg
|vo_05_01_tx                 = Happy birthday. As your path unfolds, more will join you on your journey. The world is like an inn we stay briefly before we set off on our destinations. Perhaps I'm just another passenger in your story, but on this special day, allow me to share this temporary shelter with you.

|vo_06_01_file               = {character}{language} Idle I.ogg
|vo_06_01_tx                 = (Effort sound)

|vo_06_02_title              = Idle: II

<!-- Greetings -->
|vo_07_01_title              = Self-Introduction
|vo_07_01_file               = {character}{language} Self-Introduction.ogg
|vo_07_01_tx                 = Qiuyuan, a blade drawn at your word. Wield me as you will.

|vo_07_02_title              = Greeting
|vo_07_02_file               = {character}{language} Greeting.ogg
|vo_07_02_tx                 = Name the target. I'll take care of the rest.


<!-- Join Team -->
|vo_08_01_title              = Join Team: I
|vo_08_01_file               = {character}{language} Join Team I.ogg
|vo_08_01_tx                 = A blade is honed to strike.

|vo_08_02_title              = Join Team: II
|vo_08_02_file               = {character}{language} Join Team II.ogg
|vo_08_02_tx                 = Let us proceed.

|vo_08_03_title              = Join Team: III
|vo_08_03_file               = {character}{language} Join Team III.ogg
|vo_08_03_tx                 = Leave the dangers to me.


<!-- Ascension -->
|vo_09_01_title              = Ascension: I
|vo_09_01_ascension          = 1
|vo_09_01_file               = {character}{language} Ascension I.ogg
|vo_09_01_tx                 = Clarity within, precision without. You've learned this well.

|vo_09_02_title              = Ascension: II
|vo_09_02_ascension          = 2
|vo_09_02_file               = {character}{language} Ascension II.ogg
|vo_09_02_tx                 = A chance given is a future rewritten.

|vo_09_03_title              = Ascension: III
|vo_09_03_ascension          = 3
|vo_09_03_file               = {character}{language} Ascension III.ogg
|vo_09_03_tx                 = A sharp sword is honed on whetstones, clashing blades, and shattered armor, then tempered in the fire of life. Even if it breaks, it must remain sharp.

|vo_09_04_title              = Ascension: IV
|vo_09_04_ascension          = 4
|vo_09_04_file               = {character}{language} Ascension IV.ogg
|vo_09_04_tx                 = Since you've come this far, why not cross blades with mightier foes and test your mettle?

|vo_09_05_title              = Ascension: V
|vo_09_05_ascension          = 5
|vo_09_05_file               = {character}{language} Ascension V.ogg
|vo_09_05_tx                 = In my younger days, all I cared about was keeping my blade sharp. It once felt weightless in my hand. But now, with the lives I've touched and choices I carry, my blade seems to grow heavier with each swing. My skill never falters, but something has changed...
}}
